verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer auth that lets you access, create and manipulate content. It also has an official MCP server and chat connectors for AI apps. Nothing shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec to confirm what the API covers. Missing for 10: a documented API reference showing full UI parity (object types, templates, block references, tasks, sharing, exports), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
